headline: Rolen's walk-off single off Smoltz beats Braves in 9th
recap: Trailing the Atlanta Braves 3-2 entering the bottom of the ninth, the Phillies rallied for two runs to win 4-3. Felipe Crespo led off with a single and was replaced by pinch-runner Brian L. Hunter, who advanced to third on a pickoff throwing error during Jimmy Rollins' walk and scored the tying run on Doug Glanville's sacrifice fly. One out later, Bobby Abreu singled to put runners on first and third, and Scott Rolen singled off Braves closer John Smoltz to drive in Jimmy Rollins with the winning run.

Phillies starter Brandon Duckworth allowed one run on five hits over seven innings with four strikeouts. Braves starter Tom Glavine worked around seven walks over six innings, allowing two runs on three hits.

Atlanta took a 3-2 lead in the eighth when Rheal Cormier, on in relief of Duckworth, allowed two runs without recording an out. Ricky Bottalico followed with a scoreless top of the ninth and picked up the win once the Phillies' rally beat Smoltz, who was charged with the loss and a blown save.
